_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
_note: Part of the ten-hour repurposing batch ORCH-REPURPOSING-10H-20261021. Adjacent and transferable literature: every paper that is not WWOX evidence is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, at class level, no dose, no paediatric suitability presumed, not medical advice.
OBJECTIVE: Search for WWOX-direct rows inside the SUPPLEMENTARY TABLES of large developmental-and-epileptic-encephalopathy treatment-response cohorts and registries. The R4b reading of a fenfluramine registry found one WWOX patient in a supplement (a non-responder, n=1, variant unstated, possible 'not evaluable' all-zero column) that no abstract mentions; Europe PMC full text does not reach supplementary tables, so a PubMed or full-text zero says nothing about them. Use framework/scripts/supplement_symbol_search.py (scientist-b's tool) on the supplements of every genotype-stratified treatment-response cohort you can reach lawfully, up to 12 papers.

SCOPE.outputs: your note, manifests and staged receipts; a WWOX-row inventory table in your note

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: per cohort: what the supplement is, which column carries genotype, which carries the treatment and the response, whether an all-zero WWOX row means 'no response' or 'not evaluable' (read the supplement legend or methods; say if undetermined)
every WWOX row counted ONCE: check for patient overlap between cohorts and with the repository's WWOX case series (shared patients are not independent confirmations)
explicit statement that a zero hit in a supplement licenses only 'no WWOX row in the files searched'
no inference about efficacy from n=1
DELIVERABLE: manifests, staged receipt JSONs, commit candidates, analysis note, self-eval
